name: Special Module on Inner Development
description: This is an introductory course on twin heart mediation practice in pranic healing. The topics that will be covered in this course are (i) the relationship between the physical body and the energy body (ii) the correlation between the changes in the energy body and illness (iii) prana and pranic healing (iv) the concepts, principles and practice of twin heart meditation in pranic healing. The course will also teach the methods of meditation practices for pranic healing.
